body.name: UA-DCM certified action-comparison consumer
body.construction: For each \(a,b\in A\), run the certified outer program with query \(\Delta_{ab}\).  Record a checker-verified infeasibility output as an empty contrast set and do not assign a dominance label from that output.  On a checker-verified nonempty output, label an action \(a\) certified dominant only when the checked outer lower endpoint for every \(\Delta_{ab}\), \(b\ne a\), is strictly positive.
